faq.a1: No. The calculation runs in your browser on your graphics card. Only the model is downloaded from the server.
faq.a2: Yes, 2× enlargement is free, the result has a small watermark in the corner. A clean result without the watermark costs {cleanPrice} per image, and a licence key removes it for good. The Windows app is free without a watermark at 2×, and the licence unlocks 4× enlargement.
faq.a3: In a current Chrome or Edge with WebGPU support. Without WebGPU the calculation runs on the processor and is noticeably slower.
faq.a4: The app uses the graphics card directly, without browser limits. In our measurement on an RTX 4060 it was about 2–3× faster; the result differs between computers.
faq.a5: The app accepts a result of up to 120 Mpx. In the browser a large image can run into the memory limit, so the app suits bigger pictures.
faq.a6: The web demo does, in any browser with sufficient support. The full app is for Windows only.
faq.a7: You have 14 days to get your money back.
faq.a8: Enlarging runs offline. The licence key is activated online and the app checks it when it starts. Without internet the licence lasts 7 days, then you need to connect.
faq.a9: Windows 10 (version 1903 or newer) or Windows 11, 64-bit, a graphics card with DirectX 12 support, about 1 GB of disk space and 8 GB of memory recommended.
